scripts.build: bun run build:app && bun run build:packages && bun run build:native
scripts.build:app: bun build packages/app/src/index.tsx --target=browser --minify --outfile=packages/app/dist/preview.js && cp packages/app/src/preview.html packages/app/dist/preview.html
scripts.build:native: swift build --package-path native/SimViewCore -c release && mkdir -p packages/core/bin && cp native/SimViewCore/.build/release/simview-core packages/core/bin/simview-core
scripts.build:test-fixtures: bun run build:app && bun run build:native && bun run build:probe && cp native/SimViewProbe/build/libSimViewProbe.dylib packages/core/bin/libSimViewProbe.dylib && bun run --cwd packages/cli compile
scripts.check: bun run check:toolchain && bun run check:version && bun run check:format && bun run typecheck && bun run build:test-fixtures && bun test --coverage && swift test --package-path native/SimViewCore
scripts.check:format: biome check . && xcrun swift-format lint --recursive --configuration .swift-format native/SimViewCore/Sources native/SimViewCore/Tests && xcrun clang-format --dry-run --Werror native/SimViewCore/Sources/SimViewAXShim/SimViewAXShim.m native/SimViewCore/Sources/SimViewAXShim/include/SimViewAXShim.h native/SimViewProbe/SimViewProbe.m
